141 PM PST Wed Nov 25 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1031 mb high was over northwestern Utah and a 975 mb 
low was 675 nm west of Portland, OR. West-nrothwest winds will
briefly gust to 15 to 23 knots in the outer coastal waters this
afternoon and evening. Combined seas increase to 8-12 feet 
tonight into Thursday, lowering on Friday. A Small Craft Advisory
remains in effect for the outer coastal waters through 10 AM
Friday. Generally weak onshore flow will prevail Thursday through
Monday, strengthening on Tuesday.

$$
